actions.name: tables-create-table
actions.description: Create a new table, optionally with fields.

actions.name: tables-delete-table
actions.description: Delete a table and all of its records.

actions.name: tables-create-records
actions.description: Insert one or more new records into a table.

actions.name: tables-update-record
actions.description: Update values in an existing record.

actions.name: tables-get-record
actions.description: Get a single record by its ID.

actions.name: tables-find-records
actions.description: Find records in a table with filters.

actions.name: tables-clear-table
actions.description: Delete all records from a table.

actions.name: tables-download-table
actions.description: Export a table as a CSV file.

triggers.name: newRecord
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record is added to the selected table.

triggers.name: updatedRecord
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is updated in the selected table.

triggers.name: deletedRecord
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is deleted from the selected table.
